deckIntent: Authoritative climate tech landscape analysis with data-heavy prose and stark visual contrasts. Use dark backgrounds with bright accent colors to convey urgency. Charts and statistics integrated into dense text blocks. Professional tone with environmental stakes made visceral through specific examples and projections.

cards.cardInstructions: Title card establishing the climate tech urgency narrative. Main title: 'Climate Tech at the Tipping Point' with subtitle 'Market Dynamics, Investment Reality, and Commercial Breakthroughs Reshaping Energy in 2025'. Brief overview paragraph (40 words) setting up the massive capital flows and technological inflection points. Clean typography on dark background.

Big Idea content card: 'Climate Tech Investment Hit $165 Billion in 2024 as Three Breakthrough Technologies Reached Commercial Viability'. Dense prose in 3 columns covering the investment surge, the specific technologies (solid-state batteries, green hydrogen, direct air capture), and why 2025 is the commercial inflection point. 200+ words with embedded statistics.

Section divider for market trends analysis. Title: 'Market Momentum Accelerates Across Four Key Sectors' with 100-word preview describing energy storage, carbon capture, alternative fuels, and grid infrastructure. Two-column agenda listing the sectors with brief descriptions. Accent-colored background.

Content card: 'Energy Storage Costs Plummeted 89% While Grid Demand Tripled in 24 Months'. Multi-column analysis of battery technology breakthroughs, manufacturing scale effects, and grid integration challenges. Include specific cost per kWh data and deployment statistics. Dense prose with data integration.

Data-focused card: 'Green Hydrogen Production Scales from Pilot Projects to Industrial Reality'. Prose narrative explaining the technology maturation with embedded production capacity charts and cost projections. Compare 2023 vs 2025 deployment numbers. 150 words of explanatory text with statistical tables.

Content card: 'Carbon Capture Moves Beyond Oil Majors as Startups Achieve Sub-$100 Per Ton Economics'. Analysis of direct air capture cost improvements, new market entrants, and commercial deployment timeline. Include specific company examples and cost breakdowns. Dense analytical prose.

Quote/callout card featuring a significant industry leader quote about climate tech's commercial viability, with 80 words of contextualizing prose explaining the quote's significance and the speaker's credibility. Break the dense content rhythm with visual emphasis.

Section divider for challenges analysis. Title: 'Three Systemic Barriers Still Constrain Climate Tech Scale' with preview covering regulatory uncertainty, supply chain bottlenecks, and talent shortages. 90-word description of how these challenges interact and compound.

Content card: 'Regulatory Patchwork Creates $47 Billion in Stranded Investment Risk Across Clean Energy Projects'. Dense analysis of permitting delays, policy inconsistencies, and their financial impact. Include specific project examples and quantified delays. Multi-column prose with embedded statistics.

Content card: 'Critical Mineral Shortages Will Constrain Battery Production Through 2027 Despite Recycling Advances'. Supply chain analysis covering lithium, cobalt, and rare earth dependencies. Include production capacity gaps and recycling technology potential. Dense analytical content.

Content card: 'Climate Tech Talent War Intensifies as Big Tech and Utilities Compete for 340,000 Open Roles'. Analysis of hiring challenges, salary inflation, and skills gaps. Include specific role categories and compensation data. Dense prose with workforce statistics.

Summary/closing card: 'Climate Tech's Commercial Moment Arrives Amid Structural Headwinds'. Multi-column recap of key opportunities (technology maturation, cost competitiveness, investment flows) and persistent challenges (regulatory, supply chain, talent). 100 words synthesizing the landscape for strategic decision-making.
